Courtney learns a valuable lesson about peer pressure and under-aged drinking when she becomes involved with a group of party-going college kids.
Tom blames himself for the death of a man during a failed rescue attempt. He suffers a crisis of confidence and his family rally around him in.
Chris gets his first job delivering papers. On the first day, he crashes his bike into a gate belonging to an elderly man.
As a hurricane approaches, Tom and Delaney prepare to evacuate Bal Harbor. Courtney faces an emergency of her own when she is stranded in a car.
Courtney mistakenly gives classified Institute research to a champion free-driver, Stephanie Westin. Stephanie will do anything to break the world.
Tom and Alex's marriage is strained when Tom receives a distress call from an ex-girlfriend whose husband is lost at sea.
Tom takes Jackie and a Princess Weekend. They are teamed with Susie and her dad Lionel, who is having marital problems.
Courtney becomes involved with a marine archaeologist searching for the lost city of Atlantis.
A series of dolphin attacks occur in the waters of Bal Harbor and all fingers seem to point at Flipper. The culprit turns out to be an escaped Navy.
A mysterious jet-skier causes havoc in the canals of Bal Harbor. Tom is faced with a moral dilemma when the suspect's father begins to shower him.
When a routine rescue mission goes awry, Delaney is held responsible. His career hangs in the balance as he is tried for negligence.
Audrey surprises Cap by arranging his reunion with an old flame. His nerves prompt him to create a whole new image for himself.
Jackie finds a romantic poem in a bottle. With Audrey, she sets out to find the poet, who turns out to be an attractive older man.
Delaney helps a young woman who is determined to sail solo around the world. His efforts appear to be in vain as she throws blunt insults at Bal Harbor.
Chris finds an old sword whilst diving and believes it once belonged to the famous pirate Captain Kidd. And where there's a pirate's sword.
